locked_publication_copy.deck: Sports Desk • Availability changes the next move
locked_publication_copy.body: Dr. Duckhook’s Drake Maye faces an extended absence, but New England has not confirmed a season-ending outcome. Mud Dogs’ Woody Marks missed Monday’s practice with a concussion ahead of Thursday. The Chili Cheesers awaits Brock Bowers’ day-to-day ankle decision. Three Dreaded Snake monitors A.J. Brown’s hamstring exit. Aidan Hutchinson’s confirmed season-ending ACL loss affects His Majesty’s Blood through Lions D/ST. locked_publication_copy.headline: The 200 Burger
locked_publication_copy.deck: Dr. Duckhook vs His Majesty's Blood
locked_publication_copy.body: Dr. Duckhook pulls the ribbon, raises the lid and discovers a double-decker hamburger big enough to have a title: 200 BURGER. For a moment he tries to smile like a gracious host. Then the guests understand what the number means. His Majesty's Blood has given him a celebration he can neither refuse nor explain away. The separate birthday cake waits on the sideboard.

locked_publication_copy.headline: Unlimited Firepower
locked_publication_copy.body: The LLC walks around until ObiWan Jacoby can see his face. Then he lifts his hand. Below the steps the surviving battery turns. The first white branch catches the green blade, the second lights the empty chair, and the flash swallows the defender’s silhouette. The arch lamp still burns. Derrick Henry and Mark Andrews supplied 36.20 on Monday. ObiWan Jacoby reached 166.53. The LLC held at 203.96, a margin of 37.43.
